entityFieldPolicy: All ten complete canonical Driver records, aliases/crosswalks and eight incident claims read. Definition, mechanism, scale/direction, timing, modifiability/volatility, measurements, sources/narratives/interactions and missingness preserved. No source or canonical field repaired.
rdsReview: No Family RDS. Nominal attribution locus and relative value priorities are not universally ordered scalar effects; no RDS/RelationalState direct target.
causalGateReview: Eight Driver→Driver claims STANDARD_CAUSAL. Six new primary reviews and F04/F05 reuse; all existing science unchanged.

layersConsidered.BIO: Coercion physiology/agency and sleep-loss perspective task: implicit timing, explicit agency and level-one selection distinguished; no BIO-F01 work.
layersConsidered.PSY: Agency, attribution, reactance, moral conviction/duty/values and perspective operations; state/trait and item-overlap checks.
layersConsidered.SOC: Conversation and interpersonal judgments; information access is not capacity, personal reactance not group behavior prevalence.
layersConsidered.CUL: Purity/sacred norms versus individual moralization; side-effect judgment cultural heterogeneity is not random culture.
layersConsidered.ENV: Crises/life events and value change reviewed; observational exposure is not uniform causal value hierarchy change.
layersConsidered.INS: Actual surveillance scope, legitimacy, awareness and institutional constraints differ from algorithm labels and subjective autonomy.
layersConsidered.INF: Pressure scripts, causal information, moral prompts and perspective instructions; actual information versus appraisal separate.
layersConsidered.TEC: Feedback delay and algorithmic monitoring tasks; task implementation not generic technology/agency effect.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Three task/message identities; one scoped RR threat effect, two RN proxy/conditional effects.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Everyday attribution, moral judgments and perspective conversation; no automatic causal effect inferred.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Life events/crises and personal values; heterogeneous designs and no fixed direction.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Situational restrictions/stress considered; exposure and perceived illegitimacy distinct.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Mandate/monitoring rules not identical to observed monitoring or threat.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Delay distribution/algorithm monitoring; no world-control or surveillance-scope identity shortcut.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Conversation/contact and group behavior; no social-tie/PSYWERX edge conflation.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: High-control scripts and attribution vignettes; direct perception check distinguished from downstream effects.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Sleep loss and agency-related physiology; exact task effects only, no new exposure identity duplicate.

propertyPolicy: All eleven properties considered. No nominal-locus INCREASE, whole value-hierarchy effect, implicit-agency identity or automatic capacity transfer. Unextracted property cells NOT_INVESTIGATED; no supported-null equivalence asserted.
relationshipPropertyReview: All eight reviewed before Pass B. Exact-edge moderation/pathways not supported by measured science-trust groups or SEM; no relationship-targeted effect, no B/C duplicate contribution. BIO sleep-loss identity considered for task outcomes only; no duplicated HT or prior-pilot edits.

skepticalReview.method: Independent second pass comparing design/measurement/order with canonical definitions and adverse/null/alternative findings.
checks: Dillard message booklets intermingled; scripts bundled; threat check not before negative cognition, so no causal mediation inference.
High-control effects separated from gain/loss framing nondetection and social-value threat alternative.
Reactance composite contains negative cognition; retype review not independent component causality.
Implicit/explicit agency dissociation and learned-delay reversal preserve context-specific scope.
Perspective instruction null/negative accuracy and conversation benefit do not prove general capacity.
Four-week benevolence evidence retained as positive bundle result without transient-state overcorrection or universal trait effect.
Canonical SRC197 wrong PMID and SRC163 misalignment unchanged; same-title2010/2021 moral reviews distinct, overlap retained.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: Exact attribution/agency/capacity measurements, moral-value relative profiles, aggregate outcomes, source alignment and bundle attribution. Human scientific decisions pending.
